transcript.speaker: Airport announcement
transcript.text: Attention all passengers waiting to board Oceana Air flight 502 to Hong Kong. Due to current weather conditions, all outgoing flights after 9 P.M. have been canceled, including the 9:30 P.M. flight to Hong Kong. The next available flight to Hong Kong will be tomorrow morning at 8:20 A.M. We will be providing hotel accommodations and shuttle bus service to those in need. Please speak to a customer service representative at the re-booking desk for further assistance. Thank you for your understanding. We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience.
